subject: maths
question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 8,192 in 3{ {1} over 2} years and to Rs. 9,472 in 6 years, at simple interest at a certain rate per cent p. a. The rate of interest p.a. and the sum are _____ and _____, respectively.
solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum amounts to Rs. 8,192 in 3{ {1} over 2} years and to Rs. 9,472 in 6 years

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Amount = P + S.I

Here,

P = sum

T = time

R = rate

**Calculation:**

Interest for (6 - 3{ {1} over 2}) = 2{ {1} over 2} years = 9472 - 8192

⇒ 1280

So, interest for 1 year = 1280 ÷ 2{ {1} over 2}

⇒ 1280 × { {2} over 5}

⇒ Rs. 512

Interest in 6 years = 512 × 6

⇒ Rs. 3072

So, sum = 9472 - 3072

⇒ Rs. 6400

Now,

Let rate of interest be R

So,

512 = (6400 × R × 1)/100

⇒ 64R = 512

⇒ R = 512/64

⇒ R = 8

So, rate = 8%

**∴ The rate of interest p.a. and the sum are 8% and Rs. 6400, respectively.**
